text: Vale, Reed, Lumen, and Flint pile into Mrs. Elara's for chamomile and honey cakes, trying to calm their nerves while Vale drags his scanner along just in case old records hold clues to the crashing crop yields. Reed suggests they might have to start picking favorite crops and giving up variety just to keep everyone fed. Dusk refuses the snacks again, insisting Elias's empty post is a real warning sign, and heads straight for the intake valve to investigate — dragging Reed away from the tea party to help search. The city stays split: comfort-seekers sipping tea while food supplies shrink, and Dusk hunting alone for a missing man everyone else keeps trying not to worry about.
